name: shogunagent
description: ShogunAgent: the state layer for AI agents. Add with `/plugin marketplace add Torutesu/Shogunagent`, then `/plugin install shogunagent@shogunagent`.

plugins.name: shogunagent
plugins.description: Read what is true about the user's work right now (people, projects, commitments, open loops) with a quote and a confidence on every fact; write what you learned so the next agent starts from it; run tools with L1/L2/L3 permission tiers. Not a transcript store and not a web-search tool.
